t: Introduction and overview — Mil Mi-8 Hip
name: Introduction and overview — Mil Mi-8 Hip — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Mil Mi-8 Hip
description: Introduction and overview of the Mil Mi-8 Hip: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Mil Mi-8 Hip is a twin-engine medium transport helicopter, the most-produced helicopter in history with about 17,000 built since 1967. The Soviet and Russian workhorse flies troops, cargo, and medevac missions in over 50 countries; the armed Mi-8AMTSh serves as a gunship transport. Baseline facts: Twin-engine transport helicopter; ~17,000 built by Mil since 1967; most-produced helicopter ever..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: Mil Mi-8 Hip: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.
Twin-engine transport helicopter; ~17,000 built by Mil since 1967; most-produced helicopter ever.
Key figure: Carries 24 troops; two Klimov TV3-117 turboshafts; 50+ operator countries.
